title: Summer Stir Fry
description: Quick and easy stir fry recipe perfect for warm summer evenings. Combines the flavors of summer with a savory twist.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the summer squash and bitter gourd. Stir-fry until the vegetables are tender.
Add the velvety mushrooms. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the savory soy sauce and a pinch of salt.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the vegetables and stir-fry for another minute.
Stir in the leaves of basil. Cook for an additional 30 seconds.
